dct_title_s: Indonesia Floods: Flood Proxy Map, Mar 2024
dct_description_sm: # EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Indonesia Floods, 18 Mar 2024, v0.4 The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded in Indonesia due to heavy rains that occurred on 13 Mar 2024. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the ALOS-2 satellite operated by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) before (5 Feb 2024) and after (18 Mar 2024) the event. The image covers an area indicated by the large white polygon. Each light blue pixel measures about 25m across. Preliminary Validation was done by comparing with news reports. This flood proxy map should be used as a guide to identify areas that are likely flooded, and is less reliable over urban and vegetated areas. Data were analyzed by the Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS). ALOS-2 data were provided by Sentinel Asia. **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** earthobservatory.sg/EOS-RS_ 202403_Indonesia_Floods/ **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Original data ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 Product - JAXA (2024)
